item.name: SkySelect
item.summary: Read SkySelect RFQ invitations, send quotes and no-quotes and attach part documents.
item.description:
Connect workflows to SkySelect, the aircraft parts procurement platform, as a supplier through the SkySelect Supplier API. Everyday steps read your RFQ invitations, read one invitation, decline an RFQ with a no-quote and attach certificates and other documents to your quote.

Each of the 7 operations of the Supplier API 2.0.0 has its own step, including adding a quote with its alternates and reading the quote fields of an RFQ template. Amounts are exact decimals. A connection is one SkySelect supplier account and the API key and secret of one of its users.
item.setup_summary: Generate an API key and secret in SkySelect under Settings, Developer, add them to the connection and run the connection test.
